question: What Windows installer TLS recovery policy should OpenClaw ship when npm reports `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE` during `install.ps1`?
rationale: The bug blocks first-time Windows setup, but automatic `--strict-ssl=false` retry or silent trust-root changes alter the installer certificate-verification boundary.

options.title: Security-reviewed CA remediation
options.body: Detect the TLS failure and guide or apply explicit `cafile` or `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` remediation while keeping npm TLS verification strict by default.

options.title: Interactive strict-ssl fallback
options.body: Allow a clearly warned interactive-only `--strict-ssl=false` retry while failing non-interactive installs with remediation instructions.

options.title: Diagnostics-only recovery
options.body: Keep the installer fail-closed and print precise npm CA repair guidance, accepting that affected users must perform technical remediation.

recommendation.title: Security-reviewed CA remediation
recommendation.body: Detect the TLS failure and guide or apply explicit `cafile` or `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` remediation while keeping npm TLS verification strict by default.
